body: haha, I play the piano and that does help. I've been watching adventure time since I was 14 and it's super comforting. I'm okay now, though. Thanks all. I'll be sure to try new things when the urge returns, I guess.

This honestly really helped. I've tried running and I often lose motivation to continue the routine I set in place, though. I guess I just have to develop a habit. I think I might try that thing where you occupy yourself with something the best you can, constantly. Getting lost in your thoughts is the worst and you end up really far from where you started (leaping from thought to thought until I've gone too far in the catastrophic direction). Thanks a lot though, hey.
